messages:
alex_cs: Quick day0 checklist for TigerBay private deploy — posting preflight gaps so we can assign and get ETAs.

maria_se: go for it. i'll create a CS ticket after.

alex_cs: gaps: 1) egress whitelist missing for splunk endpoints, 2) KMS key policy needs cross-account principal, 3) redwood-s3-uploader role not covered by bucket policy, 4) audit-forwarder lambda timed out during dryrun, 5) renewal ask: customer asked about 15% Q4 discount tied to SLO.

sam_infra: please share hostnames/CIDRs and i'll open a netops change.

alex_cs: hostnames: splunk-logs.tigerbay.internal, splunk-collector-02.tigerbay, splunk-s3-forwarder.tigerbay. CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/22 and 198.51.100.0/24.

sam_infra: opening NET-9210 for egress; target EOD PST.

leah_eng: KMS: they asked for arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role with Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/DescribeKey. i'll paste a policy snippet.

leah_eng: ```{
"Sid":"AllowTigerBayAccount",
"Effect":"Allow",
"Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role"},
"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
"Resource":"*"
}```

maria_se: bucket role question — do we have redwood-s3-uploader arn to allow?

alex_cs: they expect `arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-s3-uploader`. bucket prefix should be `logs/tigerbay/`.

sam_infra: i'll check bucket policy and add tight PutObject for that ARN by tomorrow noon PST.

alex_cs: lambda error snippet: `[2026-03-22T14:03:11Z] ERROR Runtime.TimeoutError: Lambda handler timed out after 30.00s`

leah_eng: short-term: bump timeout to 90s + retry; long-term: optimize S3 path. i'll raise PR today.

maria_se: created CS-4489 and flagged renewal_risk: moderate. looping salesops on discount ask (do not commit).

opsbot: IncidentBot: CS-4489 created by maria_se  TigerBay day0 cutover items. Priority: P2.

alex_cs: thanks. final asks: netops confirm 198.51.100.0/24 whitelisted and someone draft a 30m cutover runbook we can send ops.

sam_infra: whitelisting confirmed.

leah_eng: i'll post a 5-step runbook in ~30m.

maria_se: updating customer board and will follow up on ARNs and KMS rotation plan.

alex_cs: :thumbsup: will monitor and post blockers here.
